sources.snippet: Specifically, the open-weight flagship Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct outperforms a number of open and proprietary models and demonstrates competitive performance to the state-of-the-art open-weight model, Llama-3-405B-Instruct, which is around 5 times larger.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Q: How does Qwen2.5-7B compare to Qwen2 7B? A: Qwen2.5-7B brings significantly more knowledge, substantially better coding and mathematics capabilities, improved instruction following, better long-text generation (8K+ tokens), superior understanding of structured data like tables, and enhanced resilience to diverse system prompts.
